basis: Expected rows are pinned to the documented SQL semantics linked below; external engines are not executed by this fixture test.

cases.name: truth_and_null_safe_distinctness
cases.sql: SELECT NULL IS UNKNOWN AS is_unknown, NULL IS NOT TRUE AS not_true, NULL IS DISTINCT FROM 1 AS is_distinct, NULL IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULL AS not_distinct

cases.name: row_equality_and_lexicographic_order
cases.sql: SELECT (1, NULL) = (2, NULL) AS definite_false, (1, NULL) = (1, NULL) AS unknown_eq, (1, NULL) < (2, 0) AS decided_first, (1, NULL) < (1, 0) AS unknown_order

cases.name: row_membership_bounds_and_distinctness
cases.sql: SELECT (1, 2) IN ((3, 4), (1, 2)) AS present, (1, NULL) IN ((1, 2), (1, NULL)) AS unknown_membership, (2, 3) BETWEEN (1, 9) AND (3, 0) AS bounded, (1, NULL) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (1, NULL) AS same
